messages:
Nina V: Pulling together a compact action matrix from the postmortem so we can clear blockers before the next regional rehearsal. Need owners + concrete due dates.
Carlos G: Paste the matrix when ready. I'll take routing and the comms checklist.
Nina V: Draft matrix: (A) Multi-region routing playbook refinement + non-disruptive BGP sim (owner: Carlos, due 2026-04-09), (B) Restore runbook with explicit failback + approval wording (owner: Asha, due 2026-04-05), (C) Snapshot retention audit + restore-time samples (owner: Asha, due 2026-04-07), (D) Cache priming / traffic replay step (owner: Carlos, due 2026-04-09), (E) Automate preflight checks and health gates (owner: Platform Eng, due 2026-04-14), (F) Monthly restore rehearsals in non-prod (owners: Carlos/Asha recurring).
Asha P: I'll do the runbook and snapshot audit. Plan: spreadsheet with retention diffs, sample restores, and a short runbook section for rollback verification. ETA 2026-04-07.
Carlos G: For routing play I'll add a dry-run that withdraws a test prefix and verifies path re-announcement without traffic impact. Manual warm-standby promotion for first rehearsal. Will draft comms and rollback lines.
infra-bot: scheduledplaybook: "DR rehearsal - routing + restore" on 2026-03-30 23:30 UTC. Epic created RI-3120. Tickets: RI-3121..RI-3125.
Nina V: Recurring patterns noted in the postmortem: 1) KV cache cold-start after failover, 2) DNS TTL delay causing routing flaps, 3) snapshots that restore but take longer than expected. Add mitigations to the matrix.
Asha P: I'll add a cache-validation step post-restore and a small traffic-replay to pre-seed caches. Also include an explicit DNS propagation check (query across regions).
Carlos G: Agree on DNS checks. Also propose a short playbook snippet for emergency rollback: exact CLI commands, who runs them, and confirmation phrasing.
ops-bot: reminder: attach owners to RI-3120 child tickets and set watchers for SRE and Platform Eng.
Nina V: Acceptance criteria before closure: runbook merged, snapshot audit posted with restore timings, dry-run scheduled and executed, automation preflight wired, and SLI target set: restore <=45m (90p). Reconvene 2026-04-10 for signoff.
Asha P: ACK, will post audit CSV and runbook link when ready.
Carlos G: ACK, will post play draft and comms checklist.
Nina V: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
